title: Progress Report 09/2025-08/2026
content:
The ninth year of the UNESCO Chair on Heritage Futures

A new report covers the ninth year of the UNESCO Chair on Heritage Futures at Linnaeus University. During the reporting period the UNESCO Chair further strengthened its contributions to research, education, international collaboration, and policymaking. In autumn 2025, we were very pleased to welcome Dr Marcy Rockman whose expertise in cultural heritage and climate change significantly enhanced the Chair’s work on heritage in relation to sustainability and climate adaptation.
